first.unit: a newly registered job seeker, randomised at registration, stratified by office
first.arms: A: the depth-two rule decides · B: current practice (the caseworker, with the allocation tool) decides
first.primary_outcome: employed within six months of registration, from the social insurance register
first.estimand: difference in the employment rate between arm A and arm B, among all randomised seekers (intention to treat)
